name: Gravedigger
caption: The fed's own first BWC World Heavyweight Champion, crowned at the Turkey Day Tourney by beating the Rowdy One in the final.

identity.note: Shares a bare name only with gravedigger-lcw-1997 (a different, unrelated 1997 fed); a generic archetype name, no moniker or roster match.

name: The Rowdy One
caption: Tournament finalist at the Turkey Day Tourney, teams with Iron & Steel reviving the self-titled stable "A.W.I. -- Ass Whoopers Incorporated."

name: Armageddon
caption: The tournament's own pre-show favorite, upset by Missile at the Turkey Day Tourney and again by a debuting Simon MacKnyght ten days later.

identity.note: Shares a bare name only with armageddon-aicw and mike-solomon-obw's own aka (both different, unrelated feds); a generic archetype name, no moniker or roster match.

name: Missile
caption: Upsets tournament favorite Armageddon at the Turkey Day Tourney.

name: Ryan Vaughn
caption: The fed's own on-screen President, whose interference angle decides the Turkey Day Tourney final.

identity.note: Shares a bare name only with ryan-vaughn-sewf (a different, unrelated fed); no moniker or roster match.

name: "The Scotsman" Simon MacKnyght
caption: Debuts with a 27-second pinfall upset over Armageddon on the fed's own first televised weekly show.
